Message:
ksmbd: check invalid FileOffset and BeyondFinalZero in FSCTL_ZERO_DATA

FileOffset should not be greater than BeyondFinalZero in FSCTL_ZERO_DATA.
And don't call ksmbd_vfs_zero_data() if length is zero.
